parameters.formTitle: AI Act Transparency Kit · asset intake
parameters.formDescription: Register one AI-generated asset before it goes anywhere. The kit classifies it under Article 50, labels it, writes a provenance manifest and sends it to a human gate. The gate link appears on the audit view under “awaiting a human”.

values.placeholder: Midjourney v7 · ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 · gpt-4o · Kokoro-82M

values.fieldLabel: Depicts a real person (face or voice)?

values.placeholder: link or id of the person's consent, if a real person is depicted

parameters.formDescription: One asset, one decision. Everything below was filled by the line.

parameters.command: for f in /data/manifests/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")))+"\n")' "$f"; done; true

parameters.content:
## AI Act Transparency Kit — deployer side of Article 50, as a module
Two entries: its own intake form, or **Execute Sub-workflow** from any production line (pass asset_type, language, model, prompt, operator, depicts_real_person, public_information, caller_workflow and the file as binary `data`). classify → label + manifest → **Wait-form human gate** (link on the audit view) → approval log → registry of every AI system on this instance with **path analysis**: generator → publishing node, what stands in between. Returns `approved`, `disclosure_status`, `labelled_path`, `disclosed_text` to the caller.
